_comment: Editorial content for IREIT. This is a REIT scheme, not an operating company: it is a trust managed by a licensed REIT Management Company, so the fields below describe the scheme and its manager. It has no products of its own. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached.
description: Image REIT (IREIT) is a hybrid, perpetual-life REIT scheme registered with SECP on 7 March 2023 under a trust deed of 1 July 2022 between Sinolink REIT Management Company Limited, as the REIT Management Company, and the Central Depository Company of Pakistan Limited, as trustee. It holds two components: a development component — a high-end residential building with commercial shops at Plot No. 19, DMCHS, Block 7/8, Tipu Sultan Road, Karachi, of about 58,302 sq ft sellable and rentable area and targeted for completion around 2028 — and a rental component, a fully occupied office building of about 15,400 sq ft rentable area at A/33, Central Commercial Area, Block 7/8, Main Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi. Both were transferred into the scheme in June 2023 and the scheme has no financing. It listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange on 6 October 2025.
headOffice: A/33, Central Commercial Area, Block 7/8, Main Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Image REIT prospectus for its initial public offering, filed with PSX (Sinolink REIT Management Co. Limited, 2025), and the PSX Data Portal security record for IREIT, read 2026-10-17.
